instruction: A candid studio portrait photograph with a warm and inclusive atmosphere, captured in a medium close-up shot at eye-level against a plain, neutral beige backdrop. On the left, the older woman with short gray hair (R4) stands in profile facing right in a dark brown bra, smiling warmly at the camera. In the center, the woman with brown hair and bangs (R2) stands in profile in a light beige bra and black shapewear, smiling broadly. On the right, the woman with voluminous curly dark hair (R1) stands facing left in a white tank top, laughing joyfully. The three women are pressed closely front-to-back in a tight group hug; the woman with curly hair (R1) wraps her arms around the center woman's (R2) waist, who in turn wraps her arms around the left woman's (R4) waist. The scene is illuminated by soft, even studio lighting, showcasing natural skin tones.
